script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.
It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: No animal could stand against the ram, but that does not establish that nobody got in his way.
Saying the fear is not on the ram’s side implies that others are afraid. The verse does not mention fear.
Saying the goat does not stop to think attributes a thought process the vision does not describe.
The text says the ram was thrown down and trampled, not that he could not get up.
The horn prospers, but the passage does not say it is still growing or ‘on the way up’ at this point.
The vision’s connection to the time of the end does not establish what it means for the rest of Daniel’s life or his to-do list.
The text says the four kingdoms will not have the same power, but does not explicitly say each one fails to match the first king’s power. The explanation makes that comparison definite.
The text does not explicitly identify the first horn’s strength as the power being compared. The explanation makes that connection definite.
‘Borrowed’ and the oven comparison imply a source and manner of obtaining the power that Gabriel does not specify.
Saying it is not a quiet retirement adds a detail about the king’s end. Gabriel says he will be broken off, but not by human hands.
The explanation repeats that the reason is the future without adding a fresh insight or much of Papa Dorin’s personality.
Daniel says he lay ill for days, but the text does not say he was in bed.
